segments.name: Clinical asset development
segments.description: Develops and repurposes clinical-stage compounds, licensed from AstraZeneca, for licensing to third parties.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating segment focused on the research and development of clinical assets.

revenueModel.text: Licensing partners would pay up-front milestone payments and royalties on its assets after successful pre-clinical trials.
revenueModel.evidence: There is no assurance that any pre-clinical trials on the assets owned or licensed by us will be successful, however, following a successful pre-clinical trial, we would look to licensing opportunities with large biotech or pharmaceutical companies, typically for up-front milestone payments and royalty income streams for the life of the asset patent.
